scientific_assessment: The prospectively frozen single evaluation of the already-produced tokens_250000 checkpoint is sufficient and scientifically valid to complete the previously required two-checkpoint R1 selection, provided every machine admission condition below passes before model import. The evaluation is read-only and uses the same frozen Batch32 adaptive condition, decoder, scorer, TARGET_DEV, and RETENTION_SENTINEL as the preserved final-checkpoint characterization.

reasons.finding: The tokens_250000 checkpoint has a complete frozen base-and-adapter manifest bound to the preserved R1 terminal receipt and the same parent checkpoint identity as the final checkpoint.

The 250k predictions are NOT_RUN and the evaluation contract was frozen before scoring. It binds the same 192 TARGET_DEV and 96 RETENTION_SENTINEL rows, target-blind token decoder and scorer, Batch32 adaptive policy, raw-token preservation, and fresh output root.

The candidate set and selection rule are frozen before the 250k evaluation: highest TARGET_DEV net paired fixes, then lowest retention net harms, then earliest checkpoint. One valid 250k evaluation is the only missing scientific observation.
TARGET_DEV and RETENTION_SENTINEL are evaluation-only, FINAL_AUDIT remains unopened, and no training or post-scoring contract change is permitted.
The focused minimal-gate suite passes 3 of 3 tests for prospective batch semantics, adapter-independent target-blind decoding, and raw-token auditability.

required_machine_admission: Verify the exact reviewed checkpoint-manifest, evaluation-gate, selection-contract, collector, parser, inference-contract, decoder-evidence, and dataset hashes before model import.
Enumerate every base and adapter file and compare file name, byte length, and SHA256 against TOKENS_250000_CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST.json before model import.
Verify the launch checkout is the exact pushed non-main source commit intended for this evaluation, with local, origin, and RunPod parity, and record that commit in the terminal receipt.
Require the exact frozen Batch32 adaptive policy [32,16,8,4,1], batch-validation count 32, unchanged decoder/scorer, and raw-token evidence preservation.
Verify the result path, terminal receipt path, and output root are absent and fresh; reject overwrite, resume, nonce reuse, or a duplicate live job.
Enforce an active 7200-second inference runtime cap and emit a truthful terminal receipt for success, partial completion, admission failure, or runtime cap.
Fail closed before model import if any identity, provenance, output-freshness, duplicate-job, no-leakage, or authorization condition is not satisfied.
post_execution_requirements: Freeze raw token evidence, per-episode predictions, aggregate atomic, composition, retention, and TARGET_DEV counts, batch-validation evidence, result SHA256, and terminal receipt SHA256.
Apply R1_CHECKPOINT_SELECTION_CONTRACT_V1 exactly once without changing its rule after scoring.
Preserve the final-checkpoint result as POST_HOC_CHARACTERIZATION_FOR_R2_DESIGN and label the 250k result according to its actual terminal state.
Freeze the selected R1 parent checkpoint identity and submit a new stage brief before any R2 optimizer work.
review_trigger: Completion or controlled stop of the single authorized 250k evaluation, followed by immutable result and receipt hashes, exact application of the two-checkpoint selection rule, selected-parent identity, full paired deltas, and a proposed one-variable R2 curriculum adjustment.
